title: Verify Congress's procedural rules and which committee each federal issue goes to
question: Please verify, with citations to the current House Rules, the Standing Rules of the Senate and the U.S. Code, each of the following as the game states it: (1) House Rule XII: the Speaker refers each bill to the committee or committees with jurisdiction under Rule X; (2) House Rule XI, clause 2(h): a committee reports by a majority vote with a majority actually present; (3) Senate Rule XVII: the presiding officer refers each bill under Rule XXV; (4) Senate Rule XXII: cloture on a measure takes three-fifths of the Senators duly chosen and sworn; (5) 2 U.S.C. 2a: the House has 435 Representatives; (6) a federal law takes effect on enactment unless it says otherwise (Gozlon-Peretz v. United States, 498 U.S. 395); (7) a veto override takes two-thirds of the members present in each House, a quorum being present (Missouri Pacific Ry. v. Kansas, 248 U.S. 276). Then: (8) for each of the sixty issues in the us-federal policy pack, which House committee and which Senate committee it is ordinarily referred to, and the current size of each committee named; (9) what happens to a pending bill when a Congress ends, and how the pocket veto works when Congress adjourns.
whyItMatters: The Congress rule pack marks every rule above as partial because the instrument was not retrieved; only Article I, sections 3, 5 and 7, were read, from the Constitution transcript the repository holds. Committee referral is mapped by whole policy field as a placeholder (Medicare, for example, is shared by two House committees and belongs to Senate Finance), and committee sizes are the game's.
usableAnswer: For 1-7, confirmed or corrected with the exact citation and quoted operative text. For 8, a table of issue key to House committee and Senate committee, with each committee's current membership count. For 9, the rule with a citation.

answer.summary: Article I section5 supplies majority quorum; section7 supplies bicameral enactment, 10-day presidential return window excluding Sundays and two-thirds override in each house. House revenue origination is section7. Constitution alone does not supply current committee jurisdictions, staff counts or Senate debate/cloture exceptions.
